scope: Development positive control, original known TRAIN harmonics1/Re382 only; no independent validation or LLM ranking
rationale: Frozen V6 diagnostics show accurate local changes but poor long rollouts; long-score-best often near persistence. Continue latest locally learned weights, not best forecast checkpoint.
state_machine: Each epoch begins from prefix2,3. All later states are OWN predictions across ALL chunks, no later reference-state resets. Future TRAIN fields enter losses ONLY.
gradients: Truncated backprop every8 steps. Carry detached numerical own states onward; optimizer updates between chunks. NOT full238 backpropagation.
schedule: 32x50,64x50,128x75,238x125 episodes per arm:44150 predicted training steps,5550 optimizer updates if no numerical guard failures
continuation: Same model/Adam state across horizon stages; global cosine3e-5 to3e-6. Never load best during ongoing training. Save continuation including optimizer, scheduler and RNG.
objectives: Same V6 data scale(.05*trainStd), continuous NS(.01), obstacle BC(.01), own midpointFD momentum(.1) and continuity(.1). Continuous PDE sampled at each OWN chunk-prefix. No extra energy loss; log velocity energy ratio against TRAIN targets.
comparison: Two developmental arms with same schedule/loss family but distinct representation, taper and V6 warm weights. Not a pure ablation or statistically significant model ranking.
selection: Same full238 own-prediction evaluation from original prefix every10epochs+stagefirst/stagelast+initial. Lexicographic pass mass-growth screen first then meanEu/Ep. Selection never alters continuation weights.
mass_gate: Mean interior divRMS<=max(3initialDiv,3referenceMeanDiv,1e-3), reference for scoring ONLY; not full NS stability guarantee
safety: Nonfinite/abs>1000 abort current training episode; preserve failure and next epoch restarts original prefix, never later true state. No clipping/replacing predicted values. Nonfinite gradient stops arm, preserves best, records failure, next arm still runs.
coverage: Record trained steps and failures per epoch plus number of completed episodes and successful coverage of all238targets. Do not label a partial trajectory complete.
timing: Unchanged inference architecture; remeasure actual238 GPU step and step+FDmonitor, plus3x200 warm complete steps,1024x256,H200,no rendering.
inputs: Same frozen train-only normalization from69cases; same known prefix and geometry/taper. No new arrays, reference CFD or downloads.

limitations: Positive-control training and selection use same known trajectory; not unseen-case accuracy
